name: Route 37 Sunny Orchards
summary: Depart north from the Route 36 junction along the sun-drenched pastoral highway of Route 37 toward Ecruteak City. Traverse grassy knolls where wild Vulpix, Growlithe, Stantler, and Bonsly roam freely. Retrieve a valuable Focus Sash lying in the eastern glade, harvest fresh berries from the orchard bushes, and challenge roadside trainers in double battles before passing through the northern gatehouse into Ecruteak City.

items.name: Focus Sash
